test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The application forms which were downloaded from the portal (1)/ and submitted after verification (2)/ is being processed in batches (3)/ under administrative supervision. (4)

options.text: The application forms which were downloaded from the portal (1)

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in **part (3)** of the sentence due to a **subject-verb agreement** violation.
